name: unsafe fn write_volatile < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
rule: For purposes of `dst` validity, a pointer obtained by casting a reference is valid for as long as the underlying object is live and no reference, only raw pointers, is used to access the same memory; reference and pointer accesses cannot be interleaved.
api: unsafe fn write_volatile < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: it cannot represent reference-derived pointer provenance, object lifetime scope, or the prohibition on interleaving reference and raw-pointer accesses.
